Cargue lunes a las 21:45, no sé si cambió de turno de los playeros , tardaron no me ofrecieron limpiar el vidrio, me cobra me dice que el pago no entra, iba a pagar de nuevo y me dice que el pago al final entró , nunca cargo en YPF , estaba sin nafta me quedaba cerca esta estación, seguiré en shell

(Translated by Google)
I filled up on Monday at 9:45 PM. I don't know if the attendants changed shifts. They were slow and didn't offer to clean my windshield. They charged me and said the payment hadn't gone through. I was about to pay again when they said it had finally gone through. I never fill up at YPF. I was out of gas and this station was nearby. I'll stick with Shell.

reviews.comment:
Hoy fui. Después de hacer la cola por quince minutos, al momento de cargar, me dice el playero que no anda la app, sólo efectivo o crédito. Deberían avisar con anticipación. Luego voy al baño. No hay jabón. Le pregunto a los playeros y la contestación fue "no sé, nosotros no limpiamos los baños, pregúntale a la señora que limpia". Voy a las oficina y me siguen atendiendo mal sin darme respuesta. Hasta que yo mismo tuve que pedir jabón a las chicas del Full. Luego por fin, aparece un señor que por fin fue amable y me explicó qué pasaba. Pero lamentablemente la atención muy muy mal. No volvería a ir jamás.

(Translated by Google)
I went today. After waiting in line for fifteen minutes, when I went to top up my phone, the attendant told me the app wasn't working, only cash or credit. They should warn customers in advance. Then I went to the restroom. There was no soap. I asked the attendants, and the response was, "I don't know, we don't clean the restrooms, ask the cleaning lady." I went to the office, and they continued to treat me poorly without giving me an answer. I even had to ask the women at the Full service station for soap myself. Finally, a gentleman appeared who was kind enough to explain what was happening. But unfortunately, the service was very, very bad. I would never go back.
